snippet.title: VertalStrike Official Trailer
snippet.description:
VertalStrike is a tactical multiplayer FPS built for constant action. Call plays with your squad, control angles, and turn every push into momentum - run, jump, snap-turn, KILL. Multiple maps keep fights fresh, and bots let you train aim, routes, and reactions anytime. Strategy matters, but the tempo is relentless.

Website: https://vertalstrike.com/
